list: The official 55 trophies as listed by PlayStation, via PSNProfiles and Exophase (names, descriptions and grades verbatim; hidden flags per Insider Gaming's split of the list into visible and hidden trophies). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; 0 online trophies. Guide text is written for this entry, in its own words, and cites its sources beside each trophy.
sourcesNote: Source links are stored without a scheme so the app makes no network request and no absolute URL appears in its source; the app prefixes them when a reader follows a link.

trophies.guide: This pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order: finish the story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then the leftover side trophies. PowerPyx puts the whole hunt at about 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, with A Long Road (100% completion) as the hardest single trophy.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the game, so this unlocks as you play through the start of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed: just keep following the story missions until it pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing the guides flag as missable: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she talks about meditating, and accept. That meditation may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through Chapter 2's story missions to the end of the chapter. Nothing here is missable, but save manually at the start of the chapter: GTA 6 has no mission replay, so a manual save is your only way back if you want to redo a mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.label: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3's story missions. Along the way, take the optional missions and character quests as they appear: many are only offered for a while, and the quest givers tied to trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) all return after the story, so nothing here locks you out of the platinum.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4's story missions. The story runs to five chapters and about 60 to 80 hours, so by this point you are past the halfway mark. Keep scanning vehicles and studying animals as you go: progress toward Whip It Good already counts during the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, the gold for finishing the final mission in Chapter 5. Once the credits roll, free roam continues and everything needed for the 100% checklist stays accessible, so the ending is a beginning for cleanup, not a cutoff. Do not use cheats on this run: using a cheat disables trophies and saving.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks when the mission ends, as part of the story. There is no mission replay in GTA 6, so if a mission goes badly, reload your manual save rather than hoping to replay it later.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the heist mission is complete. Heist-style missions also build toward the robbery trophies, so the skills you practice here (losing wanted levels, escaping cleanly) pay off again in Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks. Like all story mission trophies, it comes automatically if you simply play the story to the end.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Complete the mission and it unlocks. No special requirement: story mission trophies only ask that you reach and finish the named mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission to unlock it. The same airport is where Catch Me If You Can happens later, so learn the airport layout here: an unscheduled departure from VCIA is its own trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. Complete the mission and it unlocks. This is the last of the named story-mission trophies; after it, the remaining story trophies are the chapter completions and the final mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: The hardest and longest trophy. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion: the checklist only becomes viewable once the story is done, but progress made during the story already counts. Work through it: every robbery, gang operation and bank vault, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's Target Decks and 70 of the 80 challenges. KeenGamer's breakdown of the checklist includes 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK spots, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 cocaine flamingos and 300 stunts. PowerPyx notes the checklist is roughly 60 percent of true completion, so finishing it is the bulk of the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. PowerPyx counts 397 stunt opportunities across Leonida, and the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep doing stunts past this trophy: the extra 50 are not wasted. Stunt jumps show on the map once found, so sweep them area by area during cleanup.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You do not need to finish or win any of them: one attempt at each is enough, so this is one of the earliest trophies you can deliberately knock out.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Shooting ranges are also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and the ranges count toward the 100% checklist, so this trophy does triple duty. Practice one weapon class at a time and replay a challenge until the gold medal lands; the medal thresholds are fixed, so a failed run costs nothing but time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so you need 14 wins, one per spot. Drone races also count toward the 100% checklist. Learn each course's line before racing it flat out: a clean run beats a fast, crashing one.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: winning the same race twice counts once, so work through the race list and tick off new ones. Races are also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None. Pick a fast, stable car for road races and save the trickier off-road and water races for when you know the routes.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so your first fishing attempt already helps two trophies. The challenge is a head-to-head against Cal: land the bigger catch or the better score, depending on the challenge's rules, and the trophy pops when you win. Cal's challenges stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end. Arcade games are also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so one completed game helps two trophies. Pick the shortest game on offer and play it through in one sitting; you do not need a high score, only a completion.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, so play it as Lucia, and do not worry if Andy disappears for a stretch of the story: PowerPyx notes that all trophy-related quest givers become available again later, and every one of them is still there in free roam after the story. Keep taking Andy's missions whenever the icon appears.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.label: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, which is normal: the questline resumes later and Kenton is available again in free roam after the story. Take his missions whenever they appear and the final one unlocks this trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Work through Billy's mission strand whenever it appears on the map. Like the other contact questlines, it is not timed against the story: Billy's missions remain available in free roam after the story, so this is a cleanup trophy if you miss any of them mid-story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions show as side questlines on the map; finish a whole strand, not just one mission of it. PowerPyx notes it is still confirming exactly which strands count, so do more than 8 if you can: the extra strands cost little and protect against one not counting. Stranger missions are not part of 100% completion, so they are a separate cleanup job after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Take Randy's missions as they appear and keep going until the strand ends. Randy's questline is one of five contact strands with their own trophy (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), and all five can be finished after the story in free roam.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only, so play it as Jason. Like the other contact strands, it is not missable: Tyrone's missions come back in free roam after the story if you did not finish them during it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.label: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and do the first one in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning, talk to Lucia in the kitchen when she says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That balcony meditation raises the counter but is not marked as a meditation spot like the rest, so it is still unclear whether it is required — do it anyway, before leaving Chapter 1, because there is no mission replay. The last spot cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. After that, sweep the remaining 17 marked spots in free roam.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia (after Down to Earth) can only be done in Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay. Do it before leaving Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's questline is about hunting: take his missions, track the marked animal, and take it down. Bret's Target Decks also feed the 100% checklist, so hunting for Bret does double duty toward A Long Road. Hunting is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None as well.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. There are 15 sets in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy pops on the way to finishing the full collection. Collect cards area by area during cleanup and check the collection menu to see which sets are one card short.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing app: open it at a marked location and post. The 100% checklist needs all 100 spots, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Sweep locations region by region in free roam and watch the counter in the Progress menu.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of them, so aim past 50 from the start: every challenge you finish counts toward both this trophy and A Long Road. Check the Challenges menu to see which groups you are closest to finishing and clear those first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.label: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner (Lucia or Jason) beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be with you when the wanted level clears, so do not let them get separated or arrested mid-chase. A quiet stretch of highway and a fast car make the escape easier; once the stars are gone and you are clear, the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.label: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of 3 close shops, rob each quickly, and keep the cops on you the whole time: losing the wanted level resets the chain. Do not stop to fight; move from shop to shop and keep the escape route in mind for after the third.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan or encounter new vehicle models as you drive around Leonida: each new model adds to the count. This is a passive trophy if you vary what you drive, and progress made during the story already counts. During cleanup, drive through different districts and check car parks, dealerships and traffic for models you have not logged yet.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all 5 before it ends. A gang shootout or a police standoff with enemies clustered in the open is the right setup; do not waste it on two or three stragglers.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: steal a plane and take off without going through the normal departure routine. The airport is the same one from the VCIA Takedown story mission, so you already know the layout. Grab a plane on the tarmac, get it moving, and lift off; the trophy pops when you are airborne and away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: This trophy is about Rhino tanks: get into trouble with a Rhino, or get into one yourself. The description is a joke about how hot it gets inside a tank, and the unlock is tied to an encounter with Rhino tanks in the game. Guide writers were still confirming the exact trigger when the list went public; expect it to involve a military response or a tank sequence, and check the sources below for the confirmed method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth is the whole requirement: get in, take the goods and get out without any alarm or witness raising the alarm. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the store can call the police. If you are spotted, leave and try again: a clean run is what counts.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are part of the robbery loop that also feeds the 100% checklist (KeenGamer lists 8 bank vault robberies for 100%), so these 5 are a milestone on the way, not a separate grind. Plan each vault: get in, crack it, and have an escape vehicle ready before you start, because the wanted level after a vault hit is heavy.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida: intercept one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. Have a fast getaway car parked nearby before you strike, and do not linger at the truck once the money is out.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Every named area on the map counts when you first set foot (or wheels) in it. This is a passive trophy during the story, since missions take you across the state, and a short cleanup job after: open the map, find the areas you have never visited, and drive through each one until the counter ticks up.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run sites marked for robbery; hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Gang operations are also a big part of the 100% checklist (39 operations), so this trophy finishes early in that grind. Keep a note of which gangs you have already hit so you do not repeat one.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. The trophy is a quiet moment, not a challenge: sit, drink, and enjoy the view. Ocean Beach is on the Vice City waterfront, so combine this with exploring the beach area for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle out of a showroom by smashing through the glass, in classic GTA style. Find a vehicle showroom, get into a car inside, and drive straight out through the front. The trophy pops on the smash-out itself, so pick a sturdy car and aim for the widest pane of glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a game. Bowling is also one of the activity types, so a game here helps Master of None too. You only need to play through at the named alley: bowl a full game and the trophy pops at the end of it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.label: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Jason and Lucia partnership reaching the public: a moment where the duo's appeal goes wide. The description is deliberately vague and the guides were still confirming the exact trigger when the list went public, so treat this as a story-adjacent trophy that pops from a partnership moment in the game. Check the sources below for the confirmed trigger as the guides update.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: This trophy tracks choices made during the story, for better or worse. PlayStation tracks a count toward it, and it pops once you have made enough meaningful choices. One warning from the guides: the Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent and cannot be undone, so steer clear of it on a trophy run. Beyond that, just play the story and make your choices; this one comes naturally.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.label: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on your next attempt, and the trophy pops. The natural place for it is any mission, challenge or activity you fail and then retry: do not reload a save to erase the failure, because the game needs to see the fail and then the success. The exact activity is still being confirmed by guide writers, so check the sources for the cleanest confirmed setup.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is the game's weird-event trophy: an easter egg or an unexplained encounter somewhere in Leonida. The guides list it as an unconfirmed unlock method, so the honest advice is to explore the stranger corners of the map (the swamps, the desert, the ocean) and watch the sources below: the community pins down these events fast, and the confirmed location will appear there first.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and bowl them over. Line up a slow pass next to a pedestrian, swing as you go past, and the trophy pops on the hit. Pick a quiet road so you can set up the pass without traffic getting in the way. The guides note the precise method is still being confirmed, so check the sources if your first tries do not pop it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists: take them to a contact who cleans money and the laundered total climbs. This is cumulative across the whole game, so every robbery feeds it. Keep laundering as you go rather than hoarding bills, and the trophy pops during the robbery cleanup.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. This is cumulative: clothes, food, weapons, car parts, anything bought in a shop counts. You will get much of the way there just by playing, and the rest is easy to finish in cleanup by buying the expensive items you actually want (cars, property upgrades, weapon stock). Check the Progress menu if you want to see how far along you are.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are properties you purchase around Leonida; each one you buy counts, and the trophy pops on the eighth. You need the money first, so this is a late-game trophy: finish the story and the big robberies, then buy the garages in one sweep. Garages also store the vehicles you collect for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the in-game vehicle app: add vehicles you own or find to it, and the count climbs with each registration. Use a mix of vehicles you already own from garages and ones you find on the road, and the trophy pops at the tenth registration.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
